text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both Fuji Kiseki and I are at a loss for how to overcome the pressure she's feeling. We watch a DVD of one of her mother's performances in the hopes we can find a hint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surely, even she must feel pressured as a stage actor. But as we watch, she doesn't give off that impression. Fuji Kiseki can't figure out why.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest we ask her mother directly how she's able to keep her cool on stage, and Fuji Kiseki agrees. We settle on a date to meet her mother.
